page.content:
Royal company the Chamberlain's Men became under James I.

How King's Men connects

  • Faction: Lord Chamberlain's Men — The Lord Chamberlain's Men became the King's Men under James I.
  • Creator: William Shakespeare — Shakespeare remained a King's Man after the royal patent.
  • Location: Blackfriars Theatre — The King's Men used Blackfriars as their indoor winter house.

What is King's Men?

The King's Men are the same fellowship after 1603: Shakespeare, Burbage, and the Globe and Blackfriars houses, now wearing the king's livery.

Key threads lead to Lord Chamberlain's Men, William Shakespeare and Blackfriars Theatre.
